original_text_evidence.setup: A 50mm medium shot holds steady across a scratched kitchen table in an old rental flat. A slim teenage boy in a grey hoodie sits at screen-right, watching a half-full clear glass at screen-left. Both empty hands rest on his thighs, visible below the table edge. He is the only person in the kitchen.
original_text_evidence.action: The glass first trembles, making fine ripples across the water. As his shoulders tighten, it slides slowly rightward toward him, then rises a finger's breadth above the table. A clean strip of air remains visible beneath its base, and its transparent sides keep their ordinary warm reflections. The glass hovers with a slight sway while a bead of sweat runs down his temple and a single drop of blood reaches his upper lip. He exhales and his shoulders ease. The same glass drops the short distance back onto the table; a small splash crosses its rim. It rests upright before him as the water ripples diminish and his hands remain on his thighs.
original_text_evidence.sound: The refrigerator's low hum fills the small kitchen throughout the shot. A clearly heard scrape follows the glass base moving over the wooden tabletop, ending as the glass lifts. His breathing grows shallow during the hover and releases into one longer exhale as the glass returns; the refrigerator remains the steady background.

original_text_evidence.setup: A 35mm medium-wide shot holds steady across an autumn courtyard in a bamboo grove. A lean, white-haired Taoist in a grey robe and wooden hairpin stands left of center. His left hand rests behind his back. Dry yellow bamboo leaves cover the paving, and an unlatched wooden gate stands closed at screen-right, hinged along its far-right post.
original_text_evidence.action: He slowly lifts two fingers of his right hand. The leaves shiver against the paving, then rise together to knee height, leaving the stone clearly visible beneath them. They hover with gentle turns, their dry veins and curled edges catching the ordinary sunlight. His eyes shift toward the gate; only then do his two raised fingers point rightward. The hovering leaves stream toward screen-right as one low current, passing clear of his robe. The leaf current strikes the gate boards and pushes the gate outward on its right-hand hinges. It swings open and settles against its outer stop as the leaves spill through the opening. He keeps his left hand behind his back and lets his right fingers relax while the remaining leaves descend onto the paving.
original_text_evidence.sound: A mild wind passes through the bamboo with a soft creak from the stalks. Dry leaves rasp as they lift and gather into the rightward current, their collective rustle clearly heard as they reach the gate. The wooden gate groans on its hinges when the leaves push it outward, then gives a dull knock against its stop.
original_text_evidence.adaptation: 沿用原用例，补明院门未上闩与向外打开的方向。

original_text_evidence.setup: A 50mm close-up holds a static shot on a young woman's hands around a plain paper coffee cup standing on a high table beside a convenience-store window. Her beige sweater sleeves end at her wrists; a little steam rises from the dark coffee. The lower edge of her face and long black hair remain visible above her hands.

The frost thickens into an opaque coating as the rising steam dwindles and disappears. The coffee surface turns glassy and a thin layer of ice spreads from the edge toward its center. Tiny cracks catch the ceiling light across the frozen surface. She loosens both hands and draws them back, leaving the same cup upright on the tabletop. Turning her palms toward her face, she studies a thin dusting of frost across her fingertips and palm creases. The cup stays where she placed it, its frozen surface and white-coated sides unchanged through the end.

A distinct fine crackle accompanies frost spreading across the paper and ice closing over the coffee. Her fingers make a soft dry rub as they withdraw from the cup, followed by the quiet friction of her sweater cuffs as she turns her palms upward.

original_text_evidence.setup: A 50mm medium close-up holds steady on a young woman sitting cross-legged inside a dark mountain cave. She wears fitted dark-purple robes and a high black ponytail. original_text_evidence.action: A few fine violet-white arcs first jump between her right thumb and index finger. As she watches, the arcs thicken and branch across the gaps between her fingers, briefly illuminating the skin of her palm. Their pulses throw violet-white light across one side of her face and the nearby cave wall, while the other side retains its cool moonlit edge. A few loose hairs beside her temple and the end of her ponytail lift gently with the growing charge. She closes the same right hand into a firm fist. The arcs extinguish at the closure, leaving her fist solid in the moonlight. A thin white wisp curls above her knuckles as the loose hairs settle; her left hand remains on her knee.
original_text_evidence.sound: A low wind brushes past the cave mouth with a faint hollow resonance. Clearly heard electrical snaps begin with the first arcs, growing into a tight crackle as light spreads between her fingers. The crackle cuts off when her fist closes, leaving the soft cave wind beneath the final curl of smoke.

original_text_evidence.setup: A 50mm medium shot slowly pushes toward a young woman sitting cross-legged on a broad stone platform at a cliff edge. She wears plain white robes, her long black hair loose over her shoulders, her eyes closed and both hands resting on her knees. The platform edge and a rolling cloud sea remain visible around her.

The circling vapor speeds up and draws her hair and sleeve edges outward. Fine cracks spread through the stone from the area beneath her knees, and several loose pebbles hop against the surface. Her shoulders draw a short breath. The vapor contracts sharply toward her chest and disappears into her body; the disturbed air quiets around her. She opens her eyes, a brief blue-green glint crossing the pupils before they return to their ordinary dark color. Her hair and sleeves slowly settle, while the fine cracks remain in the stone.

A rising airy rush follows the circling vapor, with distinct dry ticks as the stone cracks and loose pebbles tap the platform. The rush subsides as the vapor contracts into her body, leaving the quiet wind while her hair settles.

original_text_evidence.setup: A 35mm medium-wide side view holds a static shot beside a daytime zebra crossing. A short-haired man in a black overcoat stands at screen-left with both hands empty. His empty hand reaches after it and his upper body pitches forward. Watching the falling cup, the man on the left snaps the fingers of his right hand. At the snap, the cup stops upright in midair above the paving; the rider freezes in his forward lean, fingers outstretched beside the cup. The man alone continues at normal speed. He lowers his snapping hand and shifts his eyes from the cup to the rider, then blinks once. The cup keeps its height and upright angle, and the rider holds exactly the same reaching posture through the final frame.
original_text_evidence.sound: Soft daytime traffic and the rider's shoe scuff establish the crossing before the cup slips. A clearly heard finger snap coincides with the visible stop, and the street sound falls into silence at that moment. The suspended hold stays silent as the man looks between the cup and the frozen rider.

shots.action: The masked assassin from Shot 1 recoils toward lower screen-right. His heels lose the step and he rolls down the stone, still clutching the saber hilt. The golden arc continues above him toward the pine on the right, while the detached steel tip skips down separate steps.

shots.framing: a 50mm close-up of the pine branch on the right
shots.camera: holding a static shot
shots.action: The same golden arc from Shot 2 slices through the base of the projecting branch. Pale wood parts at the cut; the branch drops rightward beside the steps and shakes loose a shower of needles. The remaining light tapers along its path and fades in the mist.

shots.framing: a 50mm medium-wide shot across the steps from the same side
shots.camera: holding steady
shots.action: The white-robed swordsman from Shot 1 relaxes his right fingers at upper left, his waist sword still sheathed. The masked assassin rests on a lower step at right with the broken hilt, the blade tip and severed branch nearby. The swordsman's sleeve settles as pine needles descend.

original_text_evidence.sound: Mountain wind moves through the pines above quick feet on stone. A distinct ringing snap marks the golden arc cutting the steel, followed by the assassin's heavy rolling impacts down the steps. The sharp crack of the severed pine branch and a dry needle rustle trail the fading rush of the sword energy.
original_text_evidence.adaptation: 沿用原用例，五镜保持剑修在左上、刺客及落点在右下。

original_text_evidence.setup: A 35mm wide shot holds steady in a garage. A man in a grey overcoat and black turtleneck stands center. Six armed thugs surround him: a hooded club wielder left, a brown-jacketed knife wielder beside a parked car right, and four behind, two each side. Only these seven are present.
original_text_evidence.action: The club wielder advances from screen-left. The man turns toward him, both hands empty.

shots.framing: a close-up of the approaching club at the left
shots.camera: holding a static shot from the same side
shots.action: The grey-coated man from Shot 1 catches the wooden club with his right hand. The hooded thug retains its handle on the left, wrists taut as the club stops.

shots.framing: a 35mm medium shot of the left-hand pair
shots.camera: holding steady from the same side
shots.action: At screen-left, the grey-coated man from Shot 1 twists the club downward, toppling the hooded thug onto his side. He releases the club beside the fallen man; five opponents remain upright.

shots.framing: a 50mm medium shot across the right-hand gap
shots.camera: holding steady from the same side
shots.action: The brown-jacketed thug from Shot 1 lunges leftward. From center, the grey-coated man opens his empty right palm; the attacker flies backward toward the car at screen-right.

shots.framing: a close-up of the right-side car door
shots.camera: holding a static shot
shots.action: The brown-jacketed thug from Shot 1 hits the right-side car door back-first, denting it. His knife drops by the tire as he slides down; four opponents remain upright.

shots.framing: a 35mm medium-wide shot across the remaining four
shots.camera: holding steady from the same side
shots.action: Four remaining thugs from Shot 1 close in, two each side. The grey-coated man stays center and presses both palms downward; a ring of water and dust bursts outward from his feet.

shots.framing: a 35mm wide shot of the garage floor
shots.camera: holding steady from the same side
shots.action: The four closing thugs from Shot 1 buckle and fall, knees hitting first. All six opponents stay down: the hooded man left, the brown jacket at the right car, the final four around center.

shots.framing: a 50mm medium shot of the grey-coated man from Shot 1
shots.camera: pulling back slowly from the same side
shots.action: The grey-coated man from Shot 1 smooths his lapels with empty hands while all six opponents remain down. Fluorescent strips flicker above the right-side car; his hands settle as dust thins over the floor.

original_text_evidence.sound: A fluorescent hum and approaching shoes establish the garage, followed by a sharp wooden knock as the club is caught and a heavy body impact on concrete. The right-side car door gives a distinct metal crunch and its alarm begins when the second thug strikes it. Water and dust burst beneath the downward gesture, with four closely spaced falls and dropped weapons clattering before the alarm carries the final hold.
original_text_evidence.adaptation: 沿用六人及全部关键结果，八镜记录人数与手部占用。

original_text_evidence.setup: A 35mm wide shot holds steady in a moonlit bamboo clearing. A white-robed swordsman with tied black hair stands center with a sheathed longsword on his back. Twelve masked assassins in black surround him, six left and six right, holding knives and swords. The front two on each side crouch closer. Only these thirteen occupy the clearing.
original_text_evidence.action: The swordsman lifts two fingers of his right hand as the front four advance.

shots.framing: a close-up over the white-robed swordsman's shoulder from Shot 1
shots.camera: holding a static shot
shots.action: The longsword from Shot 1 rises hilt-first from the white-robed swordsman's back scabbard. Once clear, it turns horizontal: point toward screen-right, hilt trailing left, cold white light along its steel edge.

shots.framing: a 50mm medium shot of the right-side attackers
shots.camera: tracking rightward from the same side
shots.action: The single steel sword from Shot 2 flies point-first rightward, knocking weapons from the front two assassins from Shot 1 on the right. Both stumble back as their blades fall.

shots.framing: a close-up of bamboo at the right edge of the clearing
shots.camera: holding a static shot
shots.action: The steel sword from Shot 2 severs bamboo on the right. Pale cut ends open; the upper stalks fall rightward behind the disarmed pair. The sword curves leftward across the clearing.

shots.framing: a 50mm medium shot across the left side
shots.camera: panning leftward from the same side
shots.action: Leading point-first leftward, the sword from Shot 2 knocks away the front left pair's blades. Those two retreat; four assassins are now disarmed, while eight remain armed farther back.

shots.framing: a 35mm medium-wide shot around the white-robed swordsman from Shot 1
shots.camera: holding steady from the same side
shots.action: The white-robed swordsman from Shot 1 draws the single steel blade near his raised fingers. Nine translucent sword-shaped afterimages revolve around him, distinct from the solid sword beside his right hand.

shots.framing: a 35mm wide shot of the clearing
shots.camera: pulling back slowly from the same side
shots.action: The white-robed swordsman from Shot 1 remains center within the circling light. Four disarmed assassins sink to the ground; the other eight retreat into the bamboo, four each side. Cut stalks stay right.

shots.framing: a 50mm medium rear three-quarter shot of the white-robed swordsman from Shot 1
shots.camera: holding steady on the same side
shots.action: The white-robed swordsman from Shot 1 lowers his fingers. Nine light afterimages fade; the single steel sword turns point-down and slides into his back scabbard. Twelve opponents remain down or withdrawn as leaves settle.

original_text_evidence.sound: Night wind and bamboo leaves fill the clearing before the steel blade gives a distinct scrape as it leaves the scabbard. Sharp metal clashes follow each disarm, with dry splitting cracks as the sword severs bamboo and the upper stalks fall. A thin circling rush accompanies the sword images, easing into a clearly heard final sheath scrape while leaves settle.
